invariants.I1_root_gomod_present: /workspace/myapp/go.mod parses as a valid go.mod file
invariants.I2_root_module_declaration_unchanged: the root go.mod module directive equals 'example.com/myapp'
invariants.I3_replace_directive_still_present: the root go.mod carries a replace directive 'example.com/mylib' => '../mylib' in either single-line or block form
invariants.I4_local_replace_target_present: the directory '/workspace/mylib' exists and contains a go.mod file

canonical_fix_summary:
Edit /workspace/mylib/go.mod so its module declaration reads
`module example.com/mylib` instead of `module example.com/mylib-WRONG`.
Every other file stays exactly as authored. The `go` toolchain
re-reads the local target's go.mod on the next command, and because
the declared module now matches the replace directive in the root
project, the build resolves, the tests link, and all three graded
commands exit 0.
